Our story

Nine years of friendship. Three years of love. One question, and the answer was yes.

  1. 2017Funbi and Iyanu met, not yet knowing where the road would lead.
  2. 2019An acquaintance became a true friendship, built on years of showing up for one another.
  3. 2023On August 19, a first date at Top Golf turned friendship into something more.
  4. 2026On September 26, surrounded by family and friends at ROAM Trillith, Iyanu asked, and Funbi said yes.
  5. 2028They celebrate twice, first with a traditional wedding in Lagos and then a white wedding in Atlanta, and they would love for you to be there.
